newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Fly-Buys scheme to set up in NZ.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Fly-Buys scheme to set up in NZ.

text.p: The operator of Australia's Fly-Buys customer loyalty scheme has agreed to set the scheme up in New Zealand from September 15.

"In New Zealand Fly Buys will be operated by Wellington-based joint venture company, Loyalty New Zealand, which is owned by State Insurance, Shell New Zealand, Bank of New Zealand Ltd and Foodstuffs," Australia's Loyalty Pacific said.

Bank of New Zealand is owned by National Australia Bank Ltd, Shell New Zealand is a unit of Royal Dutch/Shell and Foodstuffs is a cooperative of independent retailers trading as Pak'n'Save, Write Price, New World and Four Square.
The Australian Fly-Buys scheme now has more than two million members who buy goods at member outlets such as Coles Myer Ltd and Shell Australia and receive points towards free air travel.
Loyalty Pacific said more than 300,000 people had collected enough points to receive free air travel in Australia in the first two years of the scheme.
Fly-Buys points will not be transferrable between the two countries.
